text: 源头淘 Yuantoutao 是面向 DSH 的电商 MCP 插件，通过 Streamable HTTP 将 yuantoutao MCP 服务接入 DSH。连接后可使用远端提供的商品搜索、商品比较及购物相关工具；无 API 密钥时，代码会以无密钥模式运行，密钥可用于连接服务并启用额外能力。适合希望在 DSH 中调用购物与商品查询工具的用户。

Yuantoutao is a DSH e-commerce MCP plugin. It connects to the yuantoutao service over Streamable HTTP and exposes its shopping tools, including product search and comparison. An API key is optional; the entry supports keyless operation. Users can call the remote shopping tools from DSH.
想在 DSH 里搜索商品并比较不同商品的价格。
有没有能让我的 DSH 助手调用电商购物工具的 MCP 插件？
I want my DSH assistant to search for products and compare shopping options.
源头淘 Yuantoutao 的功能「接入购物 MCP 工具」：插件以 Streamable HTTP 连接 yuantoutao MCP 服务，并由 DSH MCP 客户端暴露服务端提供的购物工具；连接地址和服务名称可通过配置覆盖。
源头淘 Yuantoutao 使用前须知：插件会连接 mcp.yuantoutao.com 的 MCP 服务，并可将配置的 API 密钥作为 Bearer 授权头发送；没有密钥时则发送空 headers。

dsh-plugin-yuantoutao README · Highlights 功能亮点：- **Conversational shopping 对话购物** — natural-language product search with budget and
  preference ("gift under ¥500", "cheapest, must be genuine")
- **Explainable ranking 可解释排序** — every item ships a score + per-factor reasons
  (price vs category average, shop tier, sales, coupon) you can quote directly
- **Live fan-out 实时扇出** — parallel Taobao/JD/Pinduoduo official channel queries
- **Affiliate monetization 变现** — every buy link is attributed; 3% developer share on
  attributed purchases, settled monthly
- **End-to-end fulfillment 履约闭环** — idempotent orders, WeChat pay QR/redirect,
  waybill tracking, free-return pickups

dsh-plugin-yuantoutao README · Zero-friction: works without any API key：Install, done. Read-only shopping tools (search 2M+ products, comparison, buy links)
work **keylessly** — no signup, no token, quota-free local shelf.
Add a free API key only when you want **commissions** (live fan-out, orders, 3% developer
share, withdrawal). Free keys never expire: mint at [yuantoutao.com/console](https://yuantoutao.com/console/)
or request `POST https://mcp.yuantoutao.com/mcp/trial`.

dsh plugin add github:MeshTok/dsh-plugin-yuantoutao

dsh-plugin-yuantoutao README · Configure：Set your API key (free developer key at [yuantoutao.com/console](https://yuantoutao.com/console/)):

```sh
export YUANTOUTAO_API_KEY=ak_your_key
```

Or in your profile's config: `apiKey` (plugin config), alongside optional `url`,
`serverName`, `toolCallTimeoutMs`, `failOnStartupError`.
